RT-1 — это большая языковая модель, дооб: Is RT-1 a large language model fine-tuned to control a robot?
Да: PaLM с головой для действий: Yes: PaLM with an action head
Нет: это сеть на 35 млн параметров из Ef: No: it's a 35M-parameter network built from EfficientNet and a transformer, and the command text enters it as a single vector through FiLM
Да, но языковая модель небольшая: Yes, but the language model is small
Команду кодирует Universal Sentence Enco: Universal Sentence Encoder encodes the command into a vector, and that vector sets the scale and shift of the image features inside EfficientNet. Vision-language models as the base of a policy come in lessons 3.2 and 3.3.
Как RT-1 выдаёт действие?: How does RT-1 output an action?
Классификацией: для каждого из 11 измере: By classification: for each of the 11 dimensions, one of 256 bins
Каждое измерение делят на 256 равных кор: Each dimension is split into 256 equal bins, the model predicts the bin index, and the robot gets the bin center. The same model with continuous actions completed 68% of familiar tasks instead of 97%.
Чем больше корзин на измерение, тем лучш: Are more bins per dimension always better, whatever the data?
Да: мельче корзина — точнее действие: Yes: a finer bin means a more precise action
Нет: классов становится больше, а пример: No: there are more classes and fewer examples per class, and with little data the model learns worse
Число корзин ни на что не влияет: The number of bins doesn't affect anything
В лаборатории 256 корзин на 300 демонстр: In the lab, 256 bins barely trained on 300 demonstrations, while 8 bins trained but missed because of the coarse grid. RT-1 could afford 256 bins with 130,000 episodes.
Трансформер RT-1 читает все токены шести: Does the RT-1 transformer read all the tokens of six frames, 6 × 81?
Нет: TokenLearner оставляет 8 токенов на: No: TokenLearner keeps 8 tokens per frame, and the transformer reads 48
Нет: он читает только последний кадр: No: it reads only the last frame
Мягкий отбор токенов оставляет из 81 тол: Soft token selection keeps only 8 of the 81 per frame and speeds the network up 2.4×; together with reusing the tokens of past frames, that gives 15 ms per action and a rate of 3 Hz.
Где команда встречается с картинкой в RT: Where does the command meet the image in RT-1?
В конце: токены текста добавляют к токен: At the end: text tokens are added to the image tokens before the transformer
Внутри свёрточной сети: вектор команды ч: Inside the convolutional network: through FiLM, the command vector sets the scale and shift of the features
Команда не нужна: модель узнаёт задачу п: The command isn't needed: the model recognizes the task from the scene
Это ранняя подача языка: признаки картин: This is early language fusion: the image features are extracted with the command taken into account. In Gato, language is added late, and the authors link that to its weakness with distractors: 43% versus 83% for RT-1.
